info.title: API.SH: Esports
info.description: The Esports API from API.SH: public Esports data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The stats of every game in a match. Valorant (vlr.gg): each map and the all-maps total with every player's line for all rounds, attack and defense (rating, ACS, kills, deaths, assists, K-D, KAST, ADR, headshot %, first kills and deaths), agents, and the round-by-round winner, side and how each round ended. League of Legends: each game's team totals (kills, gold, towers, inhibitors, barons, dragons) and every player's final line (champion, role, KDA, gold, CS, kill participation, damage share, wards, items, runes, skill order), patch and VODs.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/esports-game-details

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: valorant or lol.

parameters.name: match_id
parameters.description: Valorant: a vlr.gg match id or link; LoL: a match id from /esports/v1/matches?game=lol.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Valorant: only this map (name, e.g. Ascent, or its game id).

parameters.name: game_number
parameters.description: LoL: only this game of the series (1-7).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Each map (and 'All maps') lists every player's line with all / attack / defense values: rating, ACS, kills, deaths, assists, K-D, KAST, ADR,…

get.summary: Valorant and League of Legends matches
get.description:
Esports matches. Valorant (vlr.gg): upcoming and live, or results, 50 a page with teams, countries, map score, winner, event and stage, and the time until or since the match (`start_time_approx` in UTC); pass `next_page` back as `page`. Valorant filters: `team_id` (that team's matches), `event_id` (every match of an event), `date_from`/`date_to` (matches of the page on those days); each match has `has_vods`. `match_id` returns one match instead: event and stage, UTC start time, patch, teams, series score, best-of, the map veto, every map with its score, who picked it and its duration, streams and per-map VOD links. League of Legends (lolesports.com): schedule of every league or one (`league` slug from `/esports/v1/leagues`) with start time, state, block, best-of, teams with game wins, outcome and record; pass `older_cursor` or `newer_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/esports-matches

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: valorant or lol.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: valorant: upcoming (default) or results. lol: all (default), upcoming, live or results.

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: lol only: league slug (lck, lec, lpl, lcs, worlds, msi ...) or id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: valorant: page number.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: lol: `older_cursor` / `newer_cursor` from the previous answer.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: valorant only: a vlr.gg team id (e.g. 2593 for FNATIC): that team's upcoming matches or results (with `status`), paged.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: valorant only: a vlr.gg event id (e.g. 2004): every upcoming match or result of the event on one page.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: valorant only: YYYY-MM-DD; keeps the matches of the page on or after this day.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: valorant only: YYYY-MM-DD; keeps the matches of the page on or before this day.

parameters.name: match_id
parameters.description: valorant only: a vlr.gg match id (the number in the match URL): that match's details (maps, veto, streams, VODs, patch) instead of a list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: date and time as listed on vlr.gg; eta is the time until (upcoming) or since (results) the match; start_time_approx (UTC) is worked out from…

get.summary: Valorant player: agents, teams and recent matches
get.description:
A Valorant pro's profile from vlr.gg: alias, real name, country, photo and links, agent stats for the chosen period (maps played, use share, rounds, rating, ACS, K/D, KAST, ADR, KPR, APR, first kills and deaths, kills, deaths, assists), current and past teams with dates, and recent matches with each map's score, agent, rating and K/D/A.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/esports-player

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: valorant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: vlr.gg player id (9 = TenZ).

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: Period of the agent stats.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Esports standings: group tables and final placements
get.description:
Valorant (vlr.gg event id): event name, circuit, dates, prize pool, location, logo, its stages, each round-robin group table (position, team, region, logo, wins, losses, maps won and lost, rounds won and lost, round difference, advanced) and the final placements with prize money once decided. Pass stage to read one stage only. League of Legends (league slug or id): the tournament's stages and sections, each with its table (position, team, code, image, wins, losses) and its matches (state, teams, game wins, outcome), plus the league's tournaments; tournament picks another split or season (default: the latest that has started).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/esports-standings

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: valorant or lol.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: valorant: vlr.gg event id (2004 = Champions Tour 2024: Americas Stage 1, 2097 = Valorant Champions 2024). lol: league slug or id (lck, lec, lpl, lta-north, worlds, msi; see /esports/v1/leagues?game=lol).

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: valorant only: one stage slug from the stages list (e.g. regular-season, group-stage, playoffs). Default: every stage.

parameters.name: tournament
parameters.description: lol only: a tournament slug or id from the tournaments list (e.g. lck_split_2_2025). Default: the latest that has started.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Champions Tour 2024: Americas Stage 1
example.note: groups: round-robin tables per stage (record, maps, rounds, round difference); placements: final places with prize money once decided. Brack…

get.summary: Esports team: roster, ranking and results
get.description:
Valorant (vlr.gg team id): name, tag, region, logo, links, regional rank, rating, win/loss record, total winnings, roster with real names, roles, captain and country, upcoming matches and recent results with each map's score and both teams' agents. League of Legends (lolesports team slug): name, code, home league, region, images and the roster with summoner names, real names and roles.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/esports-team

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: valorant or lol.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: valorant: vlr.gg team id (2593 = FNATIC, 2 = Sentinels). lol: team slug (t1, g2-esports, fnatic).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
